scope: Public curated cow crops; cross-day same-camera identity retrieval and unknown rejection pilot, not detector-triggered end-to-end recovery
source_semantics: Dataset author paper describes merged stable cow labels across days; camera suffix verified against author loader before sampling
cohort_selection: SHA256 rank of common Aug14/Aug19/Aug20 folder IDs using prefix cow-id-sample-v1-26:, first40
model_training: None; freeze ImageNet pretrained MobileNetV3-small feature extractor; no cattle ID optimisation
file_sampling: Select five indices equally spaced over sorted camera1 file list including endpoints; require at least5; no substitution by image quality or predicted identity
eligibility: Pre-inference require at least5 camera1 crops in each required day; exclude entire identity with reason, do not replace after observing model scores

embedding.architecture: torchvision MobileNetV3 small features+avgpool, classifier removed
embedding.preprocess: official IMAGENET1K_V1 transforms: resize short side256, centre crop224, ImageNet normalisation
embedding.gallery_matching: max cosine per identity across its five reference crops; top1 nearest identity

threshold: From calibration only, enumerate score thresholds including reject-all; maximise correctly accepted known queries subject to empirical unknown false acceptance <=0.05; ties minimise known wrong acceptance, then prefer higher threshold; freeze before opening eval predictions
integrity: Audit actual image decode, dimensions, byte/pixel hashes and cross-split near duplicates; exact cross-split duplicates trigger exclusion review before inference; do not infer dates from unknown OpenCows filenames
statistics: Report counts and per-identity macro accuracy; resample identity clusters with seed26 and2000 bootstrap draws for95% percentile intervals; adjacent frames not independent trials
nonclaims: No newly trained ReID metric model
